title: Umuzigo Wazanye Gukira .
intro: Umutima wageragejwe birenze urugero warambuwe ihumure, abagenzi n’inkomezi z’umubiri. Uwo musuku wa Allah yari wenyene mu mibabaro myinshi, yahindukiriye gusa ku Bumana. Biciye ku kwihangana kudahungabana no ku gusenga bivuye ku mutima, umupfunda w’ikigongwe warashitse urengeye ivyo umuntu yari yiteze vyose. None uwo muntu ukwihebera Imana kwamufunguriye urugi rwo gusubirana ni nde?
clues: Nari umusavyi wa Allah akundwa, mfise umusesekara, urugo rutera imbere, n’amagara meza mu misi yanje.
Hanyuma ikigeragezo kiramanuka: ubutunzi buragenda, abakundwa baragenda, umubiri wanje ubwanje ukubitwa n’umubabaro mwinshi.
Abo bari hafi yanje ntibashobora kwihanganira ukuntu nari meze, nanje nca nsigara ndi ukwanje, umubiri wanje ukaba upfutse imibabaro.
Nahamagaye Umukama wanje, ndamenyesha ko Shetani yankozeko n’urushe n’igihano.
Inyishu yaraje — itegeko ryo gukubita hasi n’ikirenge canje, maze muri co hakava amazi akonje yo gukiza.
Umukama wanje yarakuyeho ingorane yose, ansubiza umuryango wanje, uragwira, nk’ikimenyetso c’ikigongwe ku bazirikana.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verse: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. (38:43)
